Blueberry overnight oats

Rolled oats soaked overnight with chia seeds and blueberries. A dense, pudding-like texture that sets in the fridge and is ready to eat by morning. Stir well before serving to distribute the softened fruit.

Prep
5 min prep
Total / resting
Chill overnight
Ingredients & Method ↓

Development edition · Awaits kitchen testing.

Ingredients Method Storage

Ingredients

How many people?
1

Estimated to serve 1 people as breakfast.

  • ½ cup (40.0 g) rolled oats
  • ½ cup (120.0 ml) milk or an unsweetened plant drink
  • ¼ cup (60.0 g) plain yogurt
  • ½ cup (75.0 g) blueberries
  • ½ banana, sliced just before serving
  • A pinch of cinnamon, optional

Contains milk if made with dairy. Check oats and alternative products for relevant allergen labels.

Method

BEFORE YOU BEGIN

Plan ahead: These oats need to rest in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours, or ideally overnight, before eating.

01

Mix the base.

Stir the oats, milk, yogurt and optional cinnamon in a clean covered container.

02

Refrigerate overnight.

Cover and place in the refrigerator overnight so the oats soften. Do not leave the mixture on the counter.

03

Finish in the morning.

Stir, adding a splash of milk if you prefer a looser texture. Top with blueberries and freshly sliced banana, then serve.

Look for: Thick, creamy, and oats have absorbed the liquid.

Serve with

The fruit brings sweetness. Taste the finished bowl before deciding whether it needs anything else. Estimated to serve 1 people as breakfast.

One way to change it up

Use strawberries or diced pear in place of blueberries. Dairy-free yogurt and a plant drink also work, with a different taste and texture.

A small technique note

Use rolled oats for a little texture. Steel-cut oats need a different method and are not a direct substitute in this recipe.

Storage & Prep ahead

Keep at 40°F (4°C) or colder. Refrigerate within 2 hours of preparation, or within 1 hour above 90°F (32°C). Discard if left out longer. Storage life depends on ingredient freshness and preparation.
